Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Bangladesh's second innings! The umpires and the West Indies players take their positions on the field. Tamim Iqbal and Mahmudul Hasan Joy are the openers for Bangladesh. Kemar Roach, as usual, has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.
... Third innings ...

It was a hard toil for Bangladesh. They sweat hard on the field but struggled to create breakthroughs. All the investments they did in the two sessions eventually paid rich dividends, especially when they took the second new ball. Mehidy Hasan was the focal point of their bowling as his 4-fer infused life in Bangladesh's bowling. Khaled Ahmed and Ebadot Hossain were also impressive and got rewarded with two wickets apiece. West Indies have gained a handy lead and the touring team will have to bat better than the last time to stay relevant in this Test match. Those grassy patches on the surface got nicely targeted by the Windies bowlers in the first innings, and expect them to do that again. Let's see how the Asian team responds...

Valuable runs from the bat of debutant Gudakesh Motie, and his knock played a critical role in taking West Indies' lead to 162 runs. It was a determined batting show by the hosts and the only thing they could have done better was to bat with more intent this morning. After consuming close to 113 overs, to score 265, in this era of Test cricket, looks a bit odd, especially on a good batting strip. Anyway, this is how they operate under Kraigg Brathwaite. Once again their skipper led from the front and formed important stands with Nkrumah Bonner and Jermaine Blackwood.

OUT! LBW! Mehidy Hasan rounds up a sensational outing with his fourth wicket to go along with a stunning catch. Hasan angles this one on a length, around off. Jayden Seales gets down on one knee, looking to sweep it away, but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Huge appeal and the finger is raised almost instantaneously. No harm in reviewing and Seales does just that. UltraEdge shows no bat is involved and Ball Tracking comes up with three reds. West Indies have been bundled out for 265 runs and have a first-innings lead of 162 runs!

Jayden Seales has been adjudged out LBW but given that it is the last wicket, he reviews it. UltraEdge is checked first and there's no spike on it. Ball Tracking shows that the impact is in line and the ball is going on to hit the middle stump. The original decision of OUT stands and the West Indies innings comes to an end.
On off this time, Jayden Seales defends it towards the fielder at silly point.
Goes fuller on middle and leg, Jayden Seales blocks it towards the fielder at short leg.
Outside off this time, Jayden Seales defends it towards the fielder at point.
Bowls fuller and on off, Gudakesh Motie eases it to short covers and takes a quick single.
Good-length delivery this time on middle and off, Gudakesh Motie taps it towards point and runs across to retain strike.

FOUR! Up and over! Khaled Ahmed gets this full on off and Gudakesh Motie makes room and heaves it over mid off. The ball bounces before the boundary and rolls towards it. The fielder is unable to pull it ball and and concedes a boundary!
Full toss on off, Jayden Seales defends with soft hands towards cover and rushes across for a single.
Yorker length outside off stump, Jayden Seales gets bat to it and bumps the ball towards second slip.
Full and outside off, the natural angle taking it away from Jayden Seales who leaves it alone.
Jayden Seales is the last man in for West Indies.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunner from Mehidy Hasan and Khaled Ahmed strikes with the first ball of his new spell. Ahmed steams in and delivers it halfway down the track, outside off. It is there to be hit and Jermaine Blackwood goes after it. Blackwood tries to force it off the back foot over covers but doesn't quite get his timing right. The ball is hit hard and to the left of short cover where Mehidy Hasan dives to his left and pouches it out of thin air. Blackwood is left stunned but has to walk back after a fine knock. The lead currently stands at 155 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Khaled Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Khaled Ahmed is brought back into the attack as he replaces Ebadot Hossain.
Lands it on off this time, Gudakesh Motie guides it to covers. They had a chance for a single but they decide not to take it.
Bowls it fuller and down the leg side, Gudakesh Motie flicks it towards backward square leg for a brace.
Outside off again from Mehidy Hasan, left alone by Gudakesh Motie.
Outside off with a hint of turn, Gudakesh Motie eases it towards point.

NOT OUT! Close but not close enough and for now, Gudakesh Motie will keep on batting. Mehidy Hasan slides this one on a length and angles it into middle. Gudakesh Motie looks to defend it off the front foot but seems to have misses it and the ball goes on to crash into the pads. Bangladesh seem certain that it is out and go up in unison but the appeal is turned down. Shakib reviews it but UltraEdge shows that the ball took the inside edge before hitting the pads. Review lost then for Bangladesh.

A huge shout for LBW but the umpire remains unmoved. Shakib Al Hasan does go for the review at the last second. The third umpire first checks the UltraEdge and finds that the ball clearly took the inside edge. The on-field decision of NOT OUT stands.
Goes fuller and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards the leg side and takes a single.
Length delivery on leg stump, Gudakesh Motie works it towards leg gully and Jermaine Blackwood refuses a single.
Full and wide down leg side. Gudakesh Motie leaves it alone.

FOUR! Wow! This is some exciting batting from Gudakesh Motie and he is getting applause from the vice-captain as well. Pitched up, around off. Motie stands tall and just drives on the up, creaming it through extra cover for yet another boundary. The lead is now over 150 runs and that could be a huge psychological advantage for West Indies.
Good-length delivery on middle. Gudakesh Motie blocks this back to the bowler.
Ebadot Hossain gets this closer and on a good length. Gudakesh Motie judges it well and lets it go.

FOUR! Thickish outside edge! Ebadot Hossain delivers this wide from off and full, Gudakesh Motie decides to go for the expansive drive over covers but instead gets a thick outside edge that flies past the slip cordon for a boundary. Jermaine Blackwood pats Gudakesh Motie on the back and seems happy with the shot.
Goes fuller and on off, Gudakesh Motie looks to block it but gets a thick outside edge as the ball rolls towards the third man. They collect three runs off it, brilliant running.
Shakib Al Hasan calls for an extra helmet onto the field and now there's silly point as well as short leg in place for the debutant.

FOUR! Gudakesh Motie is off the mark in Test cricket and what a way to do it! Bowls it outside off, Gudakesh Motie opens the face of the bat and cuts it past the backward point for a boundary. The lead grows to 141 now.
On middle again, Gudakesh Motie eases it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Gudakesh Motie defends it solidly.
On middle and fuller, Jermaine Blackwood hits it straight and hard but finds the fielder at long on. He takes a single.
Fuller in length and down the middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards the leg side.
Bowls it down leg side once again from a good length. Nurul Hasan does well to collect the moving ball by diving to his right.
Ebadot Hossain continues bowling good length but gets his radar off. This one is bowled wide from leg stump and Gudakesh Motie lets it go.
Gudakesh Motie gets a back-of-a-length delivery on middle to welcome him to Test cricket. He goes back and defends it well.
Gudakesh Motie, the debutant, is the next man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! The hard work is finally paying off for the Bangladesh bowlers and West Indies are going down in a hurry here. Ebadot Hossain goes full and outside off, inviting the drive from Kemar Roach who just doesn't have the ability of a top-order batter to not give in to the temptation. Roach gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right of third slip where Litton Das takes a very good catch. Just the two wickets remain now for West Indies and Bangladesh will be looking to clean up the tail soon.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Ebadot Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Ebadot Hossain attacks the leg stump from a good length. Jermaine Blackwood works it to deep square leg for a single.
Good-length ball outside off. Ebadot Hossain is getting good shape away and Jermaine Blackwood leaves it alone.
Fuller in length and on off with a hint of turn, Kemar Roach leans forward and defends it away.
Kemar Roach is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another sharp catch from Nurul Hasan behind the stumps and Mehidy Hasan is in the groove now. This is fuller and a bit quicker, around off. Alzarri Joseph goes on the back foot instead of playing it off the front foot. Joseph looks to play for the turn that isn't there as the ball goes straight on. He gets a thick outside edge straight into the keeper's mitts and his stay at the crease is a short one. West Indies lead by 135 runs with just 3 wickets in hand now.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Similar to the last delivery, this is again flicked towards the fielder at the short mid-wicket region.
On middle and fuller in length, Alzarri Joseph flicks it towards the fielder at short mid-wicket.
On off this time, Alzarri Joseph guides it to the short cover fielder.
Bowls it fuller and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood pushes it towards long on and takes a single.
Length ball outside off, Alzarri Joseph does not offer any shot.

Almost chops that one back onto the stumps. Ebadot Hossain bowls it on a good length and angles it in from off stump. Jermaine Blackwood gets an inside edge past the stumps and gets a single to fine leg.
Pulls the length back, and bowls it wide, Jermaine Blackwood goes for the expansive cut and is fortunate to not get bat on it. Bangladesh players appeal in unison but there is nothing to it.
Even wider this time and full, Jermaine Blackwood watches it pass him and go to the keeper.
Full delivery outside off, Jermaine Blackwood leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery on off, Jermaine Blackwood gets back and defends it towards mid off.
Ebadot Hossain (25-8-55-1) to resume his spell from the opposite end.
On a shorter length with a hint of turn into the right-hander, Alzarri Joseph blocks it well.

Fuller in length and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood nudges it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single. A better throw at the keeper's end and Alzarri Joseph would have been struggling to make it in time but it is a well-judged run in the end.
Fuller in length and on middle, this is flicked towards the mid-wicket region.
FOUR! Poor delivery this, dragged down on middle. Jermaine Blackwood pulls it hard and thumps it past square leg for a boundary.
On middle again, Jermaine Blackwood defends it towards the mid on fielder.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it to the fielder at short mid-wicket.

We are back for the final session on Day 2! A lot happened in the post-Lunch session and the game is now moving along swiftly with Bangladesh having a real shot at keeping the Windies lead to well under 200 runs. The umpires and the players make their back to the middle with Alzarri Joseph and Jermaine Blackwood set to resume their innings. Shakib Al Hasan is seen leading his side in a huddle before taking the field. It is going to be Mehidy Hasan to continue his effective spell after the break.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Session summary - 25 overs, 72 runs and 3 wickets! Bangladesh have finally been able to make inroads in the second session on Day 2 as they picked up three wickets. Khaled Ahmed bowled aggressively and got rid of the opposition skipper before he could get to his century which was a huge moment in the innings. It was then the spell from Mehidy Hasan towards the end of the session that saw him pick up a couple of quick wickets and he has given Bangladesh a chance of running through the West Indies tailenders. West Indies on the other hand have started scoring at a better rate but Jermaine Blackwood has found himself lucky a couple of times. Blackwood has the runs in his kitty but is running out of partners. It is now up to him to anchor the innings and take the hosts to a big lead which currently stands at 128 runs. Join us for an exciting final session on Day 2 at 12.30 am IST (7 pm GMT, the previous day).
Ebadot Hossain brings the length back, and continues to bowl on off, Alzarri Joseph stands up tall and defends it well. The umpire takes the bails off and it will be Tea on DAY 2.
Inswinger outside off, bowled on a good length. Alzarri Joseph decides to leave it last minute.
Good-length delivery on middle-off, Alzarri Joseph looking solid in his defensive approach.
Goes outside off and full. Alzarri Joseph is happy to leave it alone.
Ebadot Hossain goes full on off stump. Alzarri Joseph defends this firmly back to the bowler.
Back-of-a-length delivery, angled into the body. Jermaine Blackwood works it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Similar to the last delivery on leg, Alzarri Joseph flicks it towards the fielder at leg gully.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Alzarri Joseph defends it towards the fielder at short leg.
Fuller in length drifting away from the batter, Alzarri Joseph looks to defend it but misses.
Goes fuller and outside off, Alzarri Joseph guides it to point and straight to the fielder.
Alzarri Joseph is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A sharp catch behind the sticks by Nurul Hasan and Mehidy Hasan is turning it on here for his side. Lovely flight and on a nagging length as well, close to the off stump. Joshua Da Silva looks to defend off the front foot but is beaten in flight and the ball just holds its line as well. The outside edge is found and Nurul Hasan makes no mistake. The finger-wag celebration is out from Mehidy Hasan and Da Silva walks back without troubling the scorers much.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up down the leg side, Joshua Da Silva flicks it towards the fielder at leg slip.

FOUR! Hammered away and that will be FIFTY for Jermaine Blackwood, his slowest in this format of the game. Length ball, around off, Blackwood hangs back and just crunches this one through wide mid off for a boundary. Ebadot Hossain smiles back at the batter in disbelief as Blackwood raises his bat.
Full this time wide from off stump. Joshua Da Silva works it to point and gets off the mark.
Good-length delivery on middle this time. Joshua Da Silva defends it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood manages to work this to third man for a single.

Ebadot Hossain is on fire. Brings the line closer this time on a good length and it is unplayable as the ball shapes away beautifully. Bangladesh players are convinced there is an edge but the umpire disagrees. They will not review and that is the right decision.
What a beauty from Ebadot Hossain! Bowls on a good length outside off. Gets movement away and extra bounce and beats Jermaine Blackwood all ends up.
Length delivery angling it into the batter, Joshua Da Silva opens the face of the bat and blocks it away. Wicket-maiden from Mehidy Hasan.
Bowls it fuller in length, Joshua Da Silva flicks it but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Fuller one and down the middle, Joshua Da Silva blocks it back towards the bowler.
On middle again, Joshua Da Silva defends it solidly.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Joshua Da Silva eases it towards the mid on region.
Joshua Da Silva is in next.

OUT! LBW! Mehidy Hasan just loves bowling to Kyle Mayers and this is the fourth time that he has dismissed him. This is on a length, around middle and leg and seems to be going on with the angle. Mayers looks to block it off the front foot but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal and the keeper seems certain but the umpire is unmoved. It is reviewed by Shakib and UltraEdge confirms that it is pad first and then the ball hit the bat. Ball Tracking shows that the ball straightened and would have gone on to crash into the leg stump. Brilliant review this time from Bangladesh and they have another wicket in this session.

Huge appeal from behind the stumps for an LBW decision but the umpire doesn't seem interested. Shakib Al Hasan does go for the review this time. The third umpire checks UltraEdge first and the ball seems to have hit both the bat as well as the pad but it is pad first. Ball Tracking comes up with three reds and the on-field decision is overturned to OUT! Kyle Mayers is a goner.
Loopy full toss on off. Jermaine Blackwood tries to make the most of it but mistimes it to covers.
Length ball wide from off stump. Jermaine Blackwood slashes at it and misses as it goes under his bat towards the keeper.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off. There is a bit of an extra bounce but Kyle Mayers does well to fend it away past point and pick up a single.
FOUR! Punched away with authority! Ebadot Hossain bowls short again and gives Kyle Mayers some room. He leans back on the backfoot and thumps it through covers for a boundary!
Good-length delivery on leg stump. Jermaine Blackwood glances it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Streaky boundary! Ebadot Hossain starts with a short and wide loosener. Jermaine Blackwood slashes at it hard and gets a thick outside edge over the slip cordon for an unconvincing boundary!
Ebadot Hossain (22-8-38-1) is back on.
On a length and just outside off, Kyle Mayers leaves it alone. The ball just aired past the off pole and towards the keeper.
Fuller in length and on middle, Kyle Mayers defends it back towards the bowler.
Much fuller in length, Jermaine Blackwood drives it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Touch fuller on middle and leg, Jermaine Blackwood blocks it towards the vacant short leg region.
Goes fuller and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood defends it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Length again, spilled down the leg side as Mayers misses the flick.
On a length, around the top of off. This is pushed out towards mid on.
Back of a length, around middle. This is worked off the back foot behind square on the leg side for an easy single.

Almost! Khaled Ahmed keeps on being aggressive and bowls it short this time, at the body. Jermaine Blackwood looks to pull this one but gets hurried on and gets a bottom edge back onto the deck. The ball almost trickles back onto the stumps but Blackwood manages to get his right boot on the ball in time. Living dangerously here, Blackwood.
Full and wide of the off pole, left alone by Blackwood.
Back of a length, around off. Blackwood hops and keeps it out on the off side.
Shorter in length and turning onto the pads, Blackwood tucks it away fine through short fine leg for a single.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Blackwood leans forward to defend.
On a length, at the stumps. This is pushed down to mid on.

Huge appeal this time but the finger stays down. On a length, around off and turning in quite a fair bit. Jermaine Blackwood strides out to nudge it on the leg side but misses and gets rapped on the pads. After some thinking, Shakib Al Hasan decides not to review it. Oh, no! The replay shows that it would have been curtains for Blackwood had it been reviwed. Another poor decision from Bangladesh and this might cost them a lot.
Quicker and flatter, around off. This is defended off the back foot.
Flighted, on a good length and around off. The ball bounces a bit extra as it turns into the batter. Blackwood does well to adjust and fend it away.

Stifled appeal from the keeper but nothing doing says the umpire. This is full and around off, Kyle Mayers looks for the expansive cover drive but gets beaten past the outside edge. There is a noise but probably the bat hit the ground. The bowler seems confident but they don't opt for the review. The replay confirms that there was no spike as the ball went past the bat.
This is slanted across the left-hander and no shot is offered by Mayers.
Probing line once again from Khaled Ahmed. On a fuller length and pretty close to the off stump, Kyle Mayers makes an assured leave.
Nicely bowled. Fuller and into the channel around off, Kyle Mayers lets it through to the keeper.
Short of a good length, on the body. Blackwood works it off his hips behind square on the leg side for one.
This is pitched up on off, Blackwood solidly defends it off the front foot.
Mehidy Hasan spears this one into the batter's toes as Kyle Mayers digs it out back towards the bowler.
Fuller and a bit wider of the off pole, Blackwood strokes it towards cover-point and collects a single.
Tossed up this time, on middle. Blackwood nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Nicely bowled! Quicker, and angling in from around off. The ball skids on and Blackwood manages to work it towards mid-wicket.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket and Blackwood says no to the risky single.
A bit quicker and around off, Blackwood blocks it out.
On a good length, at the stumps and there's a bit of an extra bounce on this occasion. Mayers does well to fend it away.
This is banged in outside off, Mayers leaves it alone to the keeper.
On a good length, on leg. This is turned off the hips towards deep square leg for a run.
On a good length just outside off, keeps a touch low and Jermaine Blackwood gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Khaled Ahmed goes slightly back of a length angling into the body. Jermaine Blackwood works it awkwardly to point.
Good-length delivery going down the leg stump. Jermaine Blackwood tries to flick it and misses.
Fuller this time, angled into middle. Kyle Mayers keeps it out on the off side.
Around off this time, Mayers strides forward and blocks it out.
Slightly flatter and on off, defended off the front foot.
Around the wicket now to the left-hander. This is floated up well outside off and Mayers offers no shot to it.
Drifted onto the pads, Blackwood turns it 'round the corner for a single.
Starts off with a flighted delivery, on a length and on middle. Blackwood nudges it towards square leg.
Mehidy Hasan is back into the attack.
Change in bowling.
Gets closer to the line of the stumps, on a good length. Kyle Mayers gets an edge but soft hands make the ball roll over to the keeper.
Decides to bowl over the wicket. On a good length angling away from Kyle Mayers. He lets this one go to the keeper as well.
Full this time on off stump. Kyle Mayers digs it out past gully for a couple of runs.
Khaled Ahmed needs to make Kyle Mayers play from the angle but at the moment it is wide and Kyle Mayers is happy to just leave it.
On a good length, angling into Kyle Mayers. Still wide from the stumps and left alone.
Khaled Ahmed comes around the wicket and bowls a full delivery way outside off stump. Kyle Mayers leaves it alone.
FOUR! Touch short in length, outside off, Jermaine Blackwood shuffles across and smashes it past covers for a boundary. West Indies lead by 102 runs.
Length and outside off, Jermaine Blackwood defends it solidly.
Nicely flighted, around off, Jermaine Blackwood drives it towards the man at extra cover.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Jermaine Blackwood tucks it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Overpitched delivery outside off, Jermaine Blackwood leans forward and creams it past the cover fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Jermaine Blackwood defends it towards the off side.

DRINKS! So, a wicket against the run of play for Bangladesh and they will now be pumped up as the Windies skipper is sent back to the pavilion. West Indies have a sizeable lead already but they must be careful not to lose their concentration and keep on batting if they are to maximize their opportunity. The visitors though will be hoping that one wicket brings two and so on. With that being said, Kyle Mayers walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Finally, Khaled Ahmed gets the breakthrough for Bangladesh and it is the big fish. This is bowled from a bit wider of the crease and is angled in on a length around middle. Kraigg Brathwaite looks to work it onto the leg side and hops to do so but the ball keeps a shade low and Brathwaite gets pinged on the pads. A huge appeal from the bowler and the dreaded finger is raised. The skipper falls 6 runs short of what would have been another stellar hundred but it's time for some respite for Bangladesh. West Indies now lead by 94 runs.

Close again! Khaled Ahmed goes slightly fuller on leg, Jermaine Blackwood closes the face of his bat trying to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge that lobs up in the air and lands between cover and point. They cross for a run.
On a good length and nipping back in. Jermaine Blackwood comes on the front foot and it hits him straight on the gloves.
Back-of-a-length delivery, this time on middle. Jermaine Blackwood gets on top of it and blocks it well.
Good-length delivery on off. Defended towards mid off.

FOUR! This one has pierced the gap in the deep! A half-tracker from Khaled Ahmed and Jermaine Blackwood has all the time in the world to step back and pull this to backward square leg between the two fielders at the boundary.
Fuller one and down the leg side, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it towards the mid-wicket region.
Bowls it outside off this time, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it towards the mid off fielder.
On middle again and fuller in length, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it straight towards the square leg fielder and takes a quick single.
Similar to the last delivery, this is again defended towards Shakib Al Hasan.
Bowls it fuller and in the line of the stumps, Jermaine Blackwood eases it back towards Shakib Al Hasan.
Tossed up on off with a hint of turn, Jermaine Blackwood defends it towards the off side.
Time for some spin as Shakib Al Hasan (19-5-39-1) brings himself back into the attack.
Length ball going down leg, Kraigg Brathwaite tries to play at it but misses. Khaled Ahmed feels there is a slight nick but no one else agrees.
Angled into the pads from a good length. Jermaine Blackwood takes a single to deep square leg.
Good-length delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood takes a stride forward and defends firmly.
Pulls his length back, serves it on middle. Kraigg Brathwaite steps back and works it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Fuller in length and angled into the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite uses his wrists and works it square of mid-wicket for two runs.
Good-length delivery to start off with. This is bowled on off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends this to the bowler.
Bowls it fuller this time and straight at the stumps, Kraigg Brathwaite nudges it towards mid-wicket for one.
On a length and down the middle, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Bowls it on a good length, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it towards the short cover fielder.
This is much fuller and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite steers it behind point for a brace. He moves to 90 now.
Back of a length and outside leg, Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
On a length and on middle, swinging it inside, Jermaine Blackwood guides it to mid on and takes a quick single. The 50-run partnership is up between these two as well.
Goes shorter and down the leg side, Jermaine Blackwood ducks underneath it. Wide called.
Good-length delivery on middle off, Worked towards mid-wicket by Kraigg Brathwaite.

That pitched on the green patch on the surface! Good length in line with the stumps. Khaled Ahmed gets extra bounce off the wicket and Kraigg Brathwaite does well to keep the ball down off the shoulder of the bat.
Sliding down the leg side. Jermaine Blackwood works it off his hips to square leg for a single.
Fuller length on off stump. Jermaine Blackwood plays at it and inside-edges it to square leg.
Good-length delivery again on off, Jermaine Blackwood defends this back to the bowler.
Khaled Ahmed starts off by bowling on a good length but gets his line wrong. It is angling down the leg side and Kraigg Brathwaite works it to backward square leg for a single.
Khaled Ahmed (14-4-37-0) is brought back into the attack. Can he provide the breakthrough Bangladesh so desperately need?
Lands it on a good length and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards the square leg fielder.
On middle and slightly shorter, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it through mid-wicket and collects three runs. This is really good running between the wickets.
On middle this time, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it back towards Mustafizur Rahman.
FOUR! Fuller and wide outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite opens the face of the bat, uses the pace of the ball and cuts it past gully to the third man region for a boundary.
On middle this time and on a length, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it towards the short mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls it on a good length, Kraigg Brathwaite eases it towards the fielder at short cover.
Back-of-a-length delivery on middle, Jermaine Blackwood fails to keep it out and it thuds against his thigh pad.
Full and wide outside off. Jermaine Blackwood places it towards the cover fielder.
Misses his line and bowls it down leg stump from a good length. Jermaine Blackwood lets it go.
Good-length delivery angled into Jermaine Blackwood, who just about manages to get an inside edge onto the pads. Half-hearted appeal from the Bangladesh players.
Ebadot Hossain tries to compensate for the length and bowls this one short and outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full and angling into the pads. Kraigg Brathwaite flicks this through mid-wicket for a brace.
Bowls it outside off this time, Jermaine Blackwood leaves it alone.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Overpitched delivery on the off side, Jermaine Blackwood leans forward and drives it past covers for a boundary.
Touch fuller in length from Mustafizur Rahman, Jermaine Blackwood defends it to point.
Length ball, swinging away from the batter, Jermaine Blackwood defends it towards the mid off fielder.
Bowls it on middle this time, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards square leg.
Good-length delivery, shaping away, Jermaine Blackwood guides it towards the fielder at short cover.
Inswinger this time angled in from off stump. Jermaine Blackwood pushes it to mid on for a quick single.
Slightly back of a length on off, Jermaine Blackwood shuffles back and defends it towards cover.
Full and outside the off pole, Jermaine Blackwood drives elegantly but finds the cover fielder.
Short once again, giving room to Kraigg Brathwaite to free his hands. He slashes it to deep point for a single.
Full outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends this firmly back to the bowler.
Ebadot Hossain starts with a short delivery outside off stump, Jermaine Blackwood goes on the back foot and clobbers it to covers. Misfield by the cover fielder allows them to take a single.
A change in the bowling right away as Ebadot Hossain will share the second new ball with Mustafizur Rahman.
Length ball and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards backward square leg for one again.
On a good length and down the leg side, Kraigg Brathwaite awkwardly flicks it towards backward square leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller in length this time, Jermaine Blackwood drives it towards mid off. The fielder makes a good stop diving to his left. Just a single is taken.
Goes outside leg again, Jermaine Blackwood leaves it alone towards the keeper.
Much better line from Mustafizur Rahman. Bowls it fuller and on off this time, Jermaine Blackwood defends it to short cover.
Starts with a slightly shorter one just outside leg, Jermaine Blackwood leaves it through and towards the keeper.

The second new ball is now available and Shakib Al Hasan opts to take it straight away. Mustafizur Rahman has been handed the second new ball. Can he make it talk? A couple of slips and gully are in place.
Shakib Al Hasan bowls the exact same ball and Kraigg Brathwaite defends it with ease.
Full and on off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan continues bowling full, this time on leg, Kraigg Brathwaite works it to mid-wicket.
Shakib Al Hasan bowls a full delivery on off stump. Kraigg Brathwaite defends with a full face of the bat.
Full again on leg, Jermaine Blackwood works this to deep square leg for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan flights the first ball, full on leg stump. Jermaine Blackwood defends it back to the bowler.

We are back for the post-Lunch session on Day 2! The players are out in the middle and Kraigg Brathwaite along with Jermaine Blackwood is set to his resume his stay at the crease. It's going to be Shakib Al Hasan who will start off with his left-arm orthodox spin after the interval.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Right then, we've had four sessions of Test cricket and West Indies have pretty much won all of them. The match certainly seems to be result-oriented and the hosts will now look to get through Day 2 with a sizeable lead in the bank. Bangladesh however need a big effort in the field to turn the tables. It doesn't seem easy to do as the pitch does seem to have eased out for the batters. The post-Lunch session starts at 10.10 pm IST (4.40 pm GMT). Do join us then for another cracking session.

The Bangladeshi pacers were unlucky last evening and did probe well but it has been the spin of Shakib Al Hasan that troubled the opposition batters this morning. After missing out on a couple of opportunities to get rid of Nkrumah Bonner, Shakib did get the breakthrough and Bangladesh would have liked to build on it. It hasn't happened though and even the edges that have been few and far in between, seem to be falling short. They will need to create more wicket-taking opportunities in the next session to avoid toiling under the hot sun for the entirety of the day and not only that, they need something to give in order to keep the Windies' lead to as low as possible.

Session summary - 31 overs, 64 runs and one wicket. Yet another session of Test cricket has flown by and West Indies certainly seem to have everything under control at the moment. Even though the scoring rate has been slow on Day 2 as well, the hosts have started to build up a decent lead which currently stands at 56 runs. Skipper Kraigg Brathwaite has surpassed the fifty-run mark and he will now be looking to inject a bit of momentum in their innings. Nkrumah Bonner looked a bit edgy this morning and was finally sent back to the hut by Shakib. Since then, Jermaine Blackwood has lent good support to the skipper and the pair has generally found it comfortable to negotiate the bowlers.
On middle and fuller in length, Kraigg Brathwaite punches it towards the mid on fielder. That will be Lunch on Day 2.
Bowls it fuller and on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it back towards Najmul Hossain Shanto.
Tossed up on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it solidly.
Fuller and on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it to mid on and straight towards the fielder.
On middle this time, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up around off, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it but finds the fielder at mid on.
Probably the final over before the Lunch interval and Najmul Hossain Shanto will bowl it.
Slightly shorter this time on off, Jermaine Blackwood nudges it towards cover.
Straighter line on a good length. Jermaine Blackwood plays a back foot block.
Ebadot Hossain goes wider outside off this time, trying to tempt Jermaine Blackwood. He leaves it alone.
Ebadot Hossain persists with the same line and goes a little fuller. Jermaine Blackwood plays this one confidently to cover as well.
Ebadot Hossain is bowling good line and length here and is making the batter come forward. Pitched up, around off, Jermaine Blackwood knocks it to covers.
On a good length outside the off pole. Played towards cover-point.
Goes fuller and on middle giving it some air, Kraigg Brathwaite drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
On off this time, Kraigg Brathwaite hits it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Goes fuller and on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it back towards Shakib Al Hasan.
Bowls it outside off this time, Kraigg Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper.
Tossed up around off, this is pushed towards the mid on fielder.
FOUR! On middle and fuller in length, Kraigg Brathwaite gets on his knees and smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary. This is surprising from Kraigg Brathwaite with Lunch approaching.
Back-of-a-length delivery, some extra bounce on offer this time, Jermaine Blackwood gets on his toes and defends it with a straight bat. Back to back maidens!
Straight again, on a good length. Jermaine Blackwood is happy to defend this to mid on.
Goes a tad bit fuller and attacks the stumps. Jermaine Blackwood uses soft hands and plays it to mid-wicket.
Ebadot Hossain is banging it in on middle. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it back down the pitch.
Slightly shorter and angled into the batter. Jermaine Blackwood negotiates it well back to the bowler.
Full and on off, Jermaine Blackwood strokes it confidently to mid off.
Fifth maiden for Shakib Al Hasan. This is on middle and fuller in length, Kraigg Brathwaite hits it but straight towards the fielder at mid on.
On middle this time, Kraigg Brathwaite guides it towards the mid on fielder.
Full-length delivery outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite eases it towards the off side.
Bowls it outside off this time, Kraigg Brathwaite drives it towards the fielder at short cover.
This was similar to the last one, Kraigg Brathwaite eases it back towards the bowler.
Bowls it on middle and much fuller in length, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it away.

FOUR! It is just not working for Bangladesh! Ebadot Hossain bowls a lovely outswinger on a full length, tempting Jermaine Blackwood to drive. He obliges but gets a massive edge just wide of second slip. To make matters worse, the ball runs towards wide third man for a boundary! Lead crosses 50.
Full on middle, Jermaine Blackwood knocks it towards mid-wicket and tries for a single that is not there. Sent back by Kraigg Brathwaite.
Closer to the off stump this time and slightly back of a length, played towards mid off.
Good shape from Ebadot Hossain. He needs to bowl closer to the stumps as this one is wide on a good length and left alone by Jermaine Blackwood.
Back of a length this time angled into Jermaine Blackwood who defends it back to the bowler.
Ebadot Hossain starts off with a good-length delivery on middle. Kraigg Brathwaite works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Ebadot Hossain (17-6-27-1) is back into the attack.
A maiden from Shakib Al Hasan. This is on middle and fuller, Jermaine Blackwood defends it off his front foot.

An appeal from behind the stumps for LBW but it is turned down. This is the arm-ball from Shakib Al Hasan, on a shorter length and darted into off stump. Jermaine Blackwood looks to play it off the back foot but is a bit late on it. The keeper thinks it has hit the pad first and appeals vociferously but the finger stays down. The replay shows that it was all bat and no pad.
Tossed-up delivery, Jermaine Blackwood blocks it back towards the bowler.
On middle this time, Jermaine Blackwood defends it solidly.
Similar to the last delivery, this is again defended towards the mid off fielder.
Fuller and on off, Jermaine Blackwood blocks it towards the fielder at mid off.
Flighted this time on off, Kraigg Brathwaite plays it straight back to the bowler.
Mehidy Hasan consistent with his line but goes full, Kraigg Brathwaite showing his blocking abilities.
On a good length but it's bowled outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends once again.
Mehidy Hasan tries attacking the pads but pitches it around the leg stump. Kraigg Brathwaite stays solid in defense.
Full outside off, fended back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite knocks it towards mid on.
A touch shorter and around off, Brathwaite punches it out towards the cover region and picks up a single.
On off and much fuller in length, Kraigg Brathwaite defends off his front foot.
Tossed up and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it solidly.

FOUR! On middle and much fuller, Kraigg Brathwaite gets down on one knee and slogs it across the line. It beats the diving short mid-wicket fielder and scoots past mid on for a boundary. A bit unlike Kraigg Brathwaite but he took the challenge there.
On middle with a hint of turn away from the right-hander, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it away.
Tossed up outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite cuts it towards the fielder at backward point.
Back-of-a-length delivery and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood goes on his back foot and defends it back down the pitch.
Flighted full on middle, Jermaine Blackwood plays it towards short mid-wicket.
Wide down the leg side, Jermaine Blackwood lets this go.
Flatter around off, defended solidly.
Mehidy Hasan maintains an off-stump line, bowls it fuller and Jermaine Blackwood knocks it to covers.
On a good length outside off, defended back to the bowler.
On a good length and on middle, quicker too, Kraigg Brathwaite works it towards the short mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller and on the stumps, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards backward square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood flicks it towards the mid-wicket region.
Outside off this time, Jermaine Blackwood hits it towards short cover and straight to the fielder.
Similar to the last delivery, this is again defended back towards Shakib Al Hasan.
Tossed-up delivery down the middle, Jermaine Blackwood defends it back towards the bowler.
A hint of flight on this occasion, around off. Brathwaite lunges forward and blocks it out.
Straighter this time on a good length. Kraigg Brathwaite defends this towards mid-wicket.
Full and on off, defended firmly.

Close! Mehidy Hasan bowls this full and going down leg stump. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to work this leg side and gets an inside edge that goes towards leg gully. The fielder over there can't quite reach it and the ball goes through his legs. Bangladesh keep letting go of their opportunities. West Indies get two runs instead.
Slightly short and outside off, Brathwaite steps back and slaps it to backward point.
Full on leg stump. Defended towards mid-wicket.
Tossed-up delivery on middle, Jermaine Blackwood defends it back towards Shakib Al Hasan. Maiden!
Slower and giving it some air, Jermaine Blackwood presses forward and blocks it well.
Tossed up delivery, Jermaine Blackwood guides it towards the short mid-wicket fielder.
Outside off this time, Jermaine Blackwood eases it to short cover.
Goes fuller this time, Jermaine Blackwood blocks it back towards the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, Jermaine Blackwood defends it off the back foot to mid on.
On a good length and straight. Kraigg Brathwaite stands tall and defends.
Full this time on middle. Kraigg Brathwaite steps forward and knocks it back to the bowler.
Slightly back of a length, Kraigg Brathwaite steps on his back foot and punches it to mid-wicket.
Full on off stump. Defended towards silly point.
Fuller this time in line with the stumps. Kraigg Brathwaite is confident in defense.
Flights it and lands it full on middle. It's defended down the pitch.
Tossed up outside off, Jermaine Blackwood drives it straight towards the fielder at mid off.
Tossed up on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it to mid on for a quick single.
Tossed up on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite guides it to mid on.
On middle and much fuller, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it solidly.
This is floated up on the stumps, Brathwaite drives it towards mid on.
Flatter delivery, sliding into the pads. Brathwaite nudges it on the leg side.
Flighted and on off, defended from the front foot to the off side.
FOUR! Jermaine Blackwood is away in style. Floated and full, around off, Jermaine Blackwood strides forward and thumps it through extra cover for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Brathwaite gets back and punches it to covers for a run.
Spinning in from around off, Kraigg gets back to work it around but it hits the short leg fielder.
Short this time, outside off, Kraigg goes back and cuts it through point for a couple.
Flighted and full on middle, defended solidly.
Jermaine Blackwood walks in next. Also, Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the opposite end now.

OUT! TIMBER! At last, Bangladesh have a breakthrough, and their skipper has provided them with that. Shakib Al Hasan fires it in flat, an arm ball around off and skidding in off the surface. Nkrumah Bonner hangs on the back foot, offering an angled bat in defense. But it skids in, clips the inside half of his blade and goes on to disturb the stumps. The 62-run stand has been broken. West Indies lead by 31 runs.
Quicker and flatter, around off, Bonner plays late and it drops in front of first slip.
Floated and on middle, it's defended back once more.
Fuller and around off, blocked towards the bowler.
Skidding into the batter, from around middle, Kraigg moves back and nudges it behind square leg for a run.
Flighted and full, around off, defended back to the bowler.

Drinks break. West Indies continue to be on top and are now in the lead by 30 runs. Their eight wickets remain intact. Bangladesh bowled well but without any rewards. Nkrumah Bonner offered them a couple of opportunities but Bangladesh didn't appeal when there was an edge and then neither Najmul Hossain Shanto nor Nurul Hasan went for the catch when there was a thick outside edge. The tourists have themselves to blame at the moment. The only solace for them is that the hosts have not yet run away with the game due to their slow scoring rate. Will the picture change in the next hour? Let's find out.
Lands it on a length and around off, Brathwaite gets forward and plays late to find the gap at point. Takes a single.
Angling in from a length around off, Kraigg gets back and turns it towards mid-wicket.

Around off, on a length, it's defended from the back foot.
Lands it on a length around middle, Brathwaite helps it gently to the leg side and pinches a single.

FOUR! Gorgeous! Kraigg holds the pose momentarily for the cameras. Fuller in length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite transfers his weight into the drive and creams it through the gap between mid off and extra cover. Wow!
Skidding in with the angle, from outside off, Bonner plays late in his attempt to beat first slip but he finds the fielder instead.
Loopy and full, drifting in around off, Bonner is on the front foot in defense.
Full and flighted, outside off, it's driven wide of mid off for a couple of runs.
Flatter arm ball around off, full in length, Bonner defends it ahead of his front pad.
Flighted and around off, Bonner lunges and defends it with soft hands to the off side.
Fuller and on off, defended back to the bowler.
Slightly short in length, around leg, Brathwaite glances it through square leg and is content with a couple of runs.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it back to the bowler.
Angles in a length ball around middle, Kraigg stays back and quietly tickles it to mid-wicket.
Delivers it on a length and around off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it back from the crease.
Extra bounce from a good length around off, Brathwaite takes his bottom hand off the handle as he defends it to point.
On a good length around off, Kraigg defends it from the back foot.

Slightly short and around off, Bonner goes back and plays it to the left of point for one.
Gets on the front foot again and blocks a full ball to covers.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Flatter and around middle and leg, Bonner goes back and defends it to the off side from the outer part of his blade.

That is defended solidly off the front foot. End of an eventful over.
Fuller in length and outside off, stroked wide of point for a run.

EDGED BUT SAFE! FOUR! What happened there? Neither the keeper nor the first slip fielder moved. The bowler is upset and rightly so. Back of a length, around off and there is some extra bounce. Nkrumah Bonner is opened up in defense and the outside edge flies through the gap between Nurul Hasan and Najmul Hossain Shanto. Both players looked at each other as the ball went behind and crossed the fence. To be honest, that was Shanto's catch.
Gets on the front foot and dead-bats a full ball to the cover region.
Lands it on a length and around off, Bonner is on the front foot as he blocks it to the off side.
Outside off, left alone.
Wide! Wayward bouncer. Way down the leg side, Bonner lets it be. Good diving take by Nurul Hasan.
On a length, around off and shaping in, Bonner tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls to square leg. They cross.
In the channel outside off, it's left easily by Nkrumah Bonner.
A tempter this time, outside off and there to be driven, Bonner has nothing to do with it.
That is defended solidly off the front foot to cover-point. Bonner eyes a run but is sent back.

Very good bowling. Ebadot Hossain puts it on a length and close to off, Nkrumah Bonner gets forward and then offers no shot. There is some lateral movement as the ball goes very closely past the off pole.
There is certainly some zip in this pitch. Ebadot Hossain delivers it on a length and outside off, skidding away, Bonner leaves.
Goes full around off, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it safely off the front foot to mid on. West Indies' score read 111 for 2.
Presses forward and pushes a full ball to point. Finds the gap and takes a single.

FOUR! Khaled hurls across a surprise short delivery, around middle, Nkrumah Bonner plays a reactive pull shot and times it well behind square leg. Ebadot Hossain moves across to his left in the deep but fails to cut it off. Should have done better.
Pitches it up and around off, Bonner punches it down to mid off.
Angling in, from a length around off, once again it's defended off the front foot to mid on.
Fuller and on off, defended from the middle of the bat to mid on.
A length ball is sliding down the leg side, Kraigg Brathwaite tries to flick but misses. Stays on 49!
The line goes straighter this time, Brathwaite tucks a length ball through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! First boundary of this morning session and West Indies now move in the lead. Too full in length, around off, Kraigg Brathwaite squeezes it out past backward point for a boundary.
Full again, outside off, Kraigg is on the front foot this time as he defends it to the off side.
Fuller in length and outside off, Brathwaite decides to defend it from the back foot. Not a great choice given that Ebadot has the ability to bring the ball back in.
100 up! Back of a length, around middle and leg, Bonner nudges it down to fine leg for a run.
Too full and on off, defended back solidly.
Shortish and wide outside off, Brathwaite flashes and misses.
Sliding down the leg side, it's worked with the angle to the leg side.
On a length around middle, Bonner brings down a straight blade and defends it off the inner half. It rolls towards mid-wicket and they rotate the strike.
Fuller again, around off, Kraigg uses the angle of the bowler and eases it to the left side of mid on. A single is pinched.
Khaled begins his fresh spell by spearing a full ball on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite leans across and flicks it on the leg side, finds mid-wicket.
Khaled Ahmed (9-4-15-0) replaces Mustafizur Rahman from this end.

Unplayable! What a delivery! Ebadot dishes out a length delivery close to off, Nkrumah Bonner decides to play the trajectory of the ball but it straightens just a hint to beat the outside edge. Excellent over from Ebadot. The replays, later on, show that there was a spike. No one appealed. Strange.
Pitches it on a good length and outside off, Nkrumah Bonner presses forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Loose from Nkrumah Bonner, a bit uncharacteristic from him. Short in length and outside off, holding its line, Bonner tries to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Brought the last delivery in and this time around, Ebadot hurls across a length ball that holds its line outside off. Bonner leaves.
Beautiful delivery. This one lands on a length around off and nips back in sharply. Bonner fails to defend and is hit on the thigh pad. It then deflects behind towards the keeper.
Slightly short in length, close to off, Nkrumah Bonner stands tall on the back foot and defends it down on the pitch.
The Fizz comes from over the wicket for the final delivery. Lands it on a length around leg, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it calmly to the leg side.
Solid in defense. Around off, on a length, Kraigg gets half-forward and defends it to the off side.
Angling down the leg side, on a length, Brathwaite works it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Slants in a length ball on off, this time Kraigg is more confident in his stance as he covers the line and blocks it back.
Fuller this time, around off and shaping in, Kraigg Brathwaite is forward in defense and it goes off the inner edge to mid-wicket.
Wrong line. This one lands on a length around middle and angles down the leg side. Bonner clips it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Serves it on a good length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite keeps his weight on the back foot and defends it with an angled bat to cover-point.
In the channel outside off, Bonner plays it from the crease and finds the gap at point for one.

A bit of indecision this time. Ebadot Hossain delivers it on a length and outside off, Bonner takes a late call of leaving it. He though fails to withdraw his bat and it goes off the bottom half to the off side.
This time Ebadot angles in a full ball around off, forcing the batter to play, Bonner brings a straight bat down and pushes it defensively back to the bowler.
Zippy delivery. Skidding off the surface from a length outside off, Nkrumah Bonner offers no shot.
Pitches it up and outside off, Bonner drives it crisply to the left of the cover fielder. He dives and stops the ball, thereby stopping the batters in their tracks.

And again! Length ball, around off, the ball shoots up a bit more than usual but Brathwaite does well to keep it down on the off side. Consecutive maidens to start off the day by the Bangladeshi pacers.
Mustafizur Rahman looks to attack the pads this time but spills it down the leg side, Brathwaite leaves it alone and the keeper collects it safely.

A hint of extra bounce on this occasion. Fullish delivery, angling in from around off. Brathwaite looks to defend it under his eye line but gets a bit surprised by the bounce. He cops a blow on his gloves.
Back of a length, around off. Brathwaite looks to punch it off the back foot but his feet don't move much and Brathwaite mistimes it back onto the deck.
Slower in pace and angled into middle, Brathwaite stays in his crease and defends it back to the bowler.
Mustafizur Rahman starts from around the stumps and angles in a length ball on off stump. Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it out off the front foot.
Mustafizur Rahman to share the attack from the opposite end.
Maiden to start with! A touch fuller and outside off, easy leave for Nkrumah Bonner.
On a length again, but a bit outside the line of off stump, Bonner shoulders arms at it.
BEATEN! Probing delivery from Ebadot Hossain, length, outside off and shaping back in quite a fair bit. Nkrumah Bonner has to play at it and gets beaten past the outside edge.
On a driving length but on the fifth stump line, Bonner watches it all the way through and decides not to play at it.
The length is pulled back this time and it is bowled pretty wide outside off, Bonner lets it through to the keeper.
Nice shape! Ebadot Hossain starts off with a fuller-length delivery from wide of the crease. The ball shapes back in nicely from outside off as Nkrumah Bonner defends it out solidly.

Time to get underway! The sun is presently out and there is a steady breeze blowing across the stadium. The conditions look ripe for batting and if the batters see off the first 30 minutes safely, they can get big runs here. Kraigg Brathwaite and Nkrumah Bonner are the overnight batters. The latter will be on strike as Ebadot Hossain gets ready to serve the first over of the day. Here we go...

Pitch report - Darren Ganga mentions that the moisture from Day 1 isn't there anymore but the conditions are similar and the spinners might come into play a bit more. Sir Curtly Ambrose joins him and says that the West Indies got the better part of the day to bowl but the intent to score runs wasn't there from their batters and he hopes that changes on Day 2.

Alzarri Joseph comes up for a quick word. The tall pacer says that he enjoyed bowling with the red ball after coming back from the white-ball format. Adds that there is always room for improvement and he could have been a touch fuller with his length. Mentions that he doesn't try to follow in anyone's footsteps and looks to create his own way. States that the pitch got better in the evening and feels that Day 2 should be the best day for batting.

While we wait for proceedings to begin on Day 2, England are taking on Netherlands in a one-day game where the English batters, riding on tons from Philip Salt, Dawid Malan and Jos Buttler have put on a world record score of 498 runs on the board. With the white ball game getting more and more batting oriented, will this record score ever be broken?

The hosts on the other hand will be mightily pleased with their exploits of Day 1 with all four pacers putting on a strong showing and getting rewarded thoroughly. On the batting front, runs were hard to come by for West Indies though but skipper Kraigg Brathwaite has held up one end really well. With the hosts trailing by just 8 runs and the wicket easing out, it could go from bad to worse for the visitors and they will need wickets in the first session to have some sort of say in the game. Will the Windies pile on the pressure and score big? Or will Bangladesh make some sort of a comeback? Find out as the first session is coming up in some time.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 2 of the first Test between West Indies and Bangladesh. The visitors were bundled out for 103 with six batters getting out without troubling the scorers which meant for the first time in the history of Test cricket that a side had six batters out for a duck in back-to-back matches. The skipper, Shakib Al Hasan was the only bright spark in their innings and even their bowlers had to toil hard to get a couple of breakthroughs.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Right then, West Indies hold all the aces heading into the second day. Their bowlers earned them the advantage and now it's the turn of their batters to extend it further and corner Bangladesh even more. Can they bat the touring team out of this Test match? Find out on Day 2 with action starting at 7.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT). Our build-up however will begin much sooner. Do join us then, take care and goodbye!

Kemar Roach (8-2-21-2) comes up for a quick chat. The speedster says that they adjusted well as the pitch was tough to adjust, in terms of length. Talks about the grassy patch and mentions that they tried to hit those areas. Feels that winning the toss was important and shares that it's always best to bowl first in Antigua. Adds that it's a tough pitch to bat on and praises Kraigg Brathwaite for leading them well. Hopes to fight hard on Day 2 and get a good lead.

It was a hard toil for the Bangladeshi bowlers but they bowled really well. It's just that they didn't have luck on their side and a couple of missed opportunities in the field too have cost them. With batting conditions almost certainly to get better, it could be a long and hard day for them if they don't manage to pick up early wickets. Mustafizur Rahman was simply sensational and Ebadot Hossain probed well but they could only pick up a couple of wickets in total to go with their poor batting performance from earlier in the day.

West Indies lost a couple of wickets in the final session and only managed to score 80 runs in 33 overs. Given the pitch conditions, they would rather have wickets in hand for Day 2 as the pitch will get better for batting then. Kraigg Brathwaite as usual has been the rock for his team and has faced 149 balls for his 42. It will be interesting to see if he can build on the start and score a bit more freely. John Campbell and Raymon Reifer looked good for a bit at the top of the order but got out. Nkrumah Bonner is out there and will be looking to put on a big stand with his skipper come Day 2.

Welcome back to our coverage of the final session of Day 1 of the first Test match between West Indies and Bangladesh. The hosts will be looking to build on the platform laid down by the openers who have negotiated the new ball well. Bangladesh on the other hand will want to restrict West Indies in their first innings to a low total. They did bowl 10 maiden overs in the first 15 overs but they need wickets now. Let us resume witnessing this engrossing battle between bat and ball!
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

Another session belonged to West Indies! They took very little time to pick the remaining four wickets and folded out Bangladesh for a paltry total. Had it not been for a counter-attacking half-century by the newly elected captain Shakib Al Hasan, the touring team would have struggled to touch even 100. In reply, the West Indian openers started very watchfully and have managed to preserve all their wickets. Kraigg Brathwaite did offer them a chance but Mominul Haque dropped the catch. Post that, it was all about the hosts putting up a strong defensive display. The bowlers have dominated thus far. Bangladesh didn't get any wickets but bowled very tidily. Do join us at 12.30 am local (7 pm GMT, previous day) to see whether the bat can dominate the ball in the final session of Day 1.
Back of a length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone towards the keeper. That will be Tea on Day 1.
Touch fuller this time, Brathwaite defends it out solidly.
Good-length delivery outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite looks to play at it but gets an outside edge. The ball rolls towards the slip.
Slightly shorter angling into the batter, Kraigg Brathwaite hops a bit and blocks it away.
Bowls it outside off this time, Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
On a length and on off, Kraigg Brathwaite eases it towards short cover and straight to the fielder.
Mehidy Hasan switches to around the wicket and floats it up around middle and leg. John Campbell defends it off the front foot.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Brathwaite backs away and taps it towards the cover region for a quick single. Good running.
Flatter delivery, on middle, Brathwaite keeps it out.
Brathwaite looks to use his feet now but Hasan sees him coming. Hasan pulls back the length and angles it into the pads, Brathwaite defends it out.

FOUR! First sign of aggression from Brathwaite and he picks up a boundary, the first of the innings. Darted in on leg stump, Brathwaite gets low and slogs it into the vacant square leg region for a boundary.
Uppish but safe! Mehidy Hasan starts off with a speared-in delivery on the pads, Brathwaite flicks it just past short leg and towards square leg.
Mehidy Hasan is ready to bowl now after just one over from Shakib Al Hasan. Maybe, he wants a change of ends.
Good-length delivery just outside off, Campbell tries to block it but misses. The ball just aired past his blade and goes into the gloves of the keeper.
On a length and on middle, Campbell defends it solidly.
Bowls it outside off, John Campbell looks to slap it but misses.
Good-length delivery on middle, John Campbell defends it out. The ball bounces back near the stumps and he blocks it with his leg.
On middle this time and on a length, John Campbell defends it back towards the bowler.
Goes 'round the wicket. Bowls it on a length and outside off, John Campbell looks to play at it but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces back towards the keeper.
Quicker and flatter, darted into middle. Brathwaite blocks it out. Shakib Al Hasan starts off with a maiden.
Tossed up this time, around off. Kraigg Brathwaite looks to drive it through covers but mistimes it towards silly mid off.
Nicely flighted and angled into middle, Brathwaite watches it well and keeps it out.
A bit quicker through the air and on off, Brathwaite strides out to defend.
Floated up on off stump, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Starts off with an in-drifter on middle and leg, Brathwaite nudges it out on the leg side.
Shakib Al Hasan brings himself into the attack.
Back-of-a-length delivery, Brathwaite guides it towards covers and rotates the strike.
A brilliant inswinger. Fuller in length following the batter, Brathwaite blocks it out solidly. Oh, it's a no ball. A late call from the umpire and he has recalled the bowler to bowl the final ball.
Good-length delivery wide outside off, Brathwaite lets it go through and towards the keeper.
Ebadot Hossain keeps bowling it on a length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite doesn't bother at it and lets it go towards the keeper.
Similar to the last delivery, Kraigg Brathwaite again leaves it through and towards the keeper.
On a good length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite shoulders arms at it.
Starts with a fuller one on off, Kraigg Brathwaite looks to defend it but gets a thick inside edge. The ball rolls towards the short mid-wicket region.
On off, Campbell pats it towards mid on.
Around off, Campbell leaves it alone this time.

Just short! Khaled Ahmed bowls it around the top of off and the ball just nips back in ever so slightly. John Campbell has a poke at it with soft hands but gets an outside edge that lands in front of the man at second slip.
Pitched up, outside off and this one shapes away a fair bit after passing the batter. John Campbell offers no shot.
In that channel outside off, Campbell lets it through to the keeper.
Length, around off, Brathwaite pushes at it off the front foot and picks up a single towards cover-point.
Length ball, on off. Campbell defends it off the front foot.
Short of a length and around off, Campbell looks to cut from too close to the body but edges it back onto the deck.
Some issues with the landing area. Mustafizur Rahman is not happy, maybe some loose soil there. The groundsmen have been asked to fix the issue.

Mustafizur Rahman pulls back the length and tries to attack the pads but spills it down the leg side. Campbell fails to get any bat on it. Also, the Fizz slips while in his stride and is a bit concerned with the landing area.
Full, on off and shaping away. John Campbell keeps it out on the off side.
In the gap! Good-length ball, around the hips. Brathwaite plays at it with soft hands and keeps it down towards the vacant short leg region. Brathwaite picks up a single.
This is on a fuller length and slanted well across the right-hander. Brathwaite leaves it alone.
The maidens keep on coming, still just the one over scored off by West Indies. A length ball, angled in around off. John Campbell pushes it out towards the cover region.
On the fifth stump line and quite full, Campbell isn't interested in playing at it.
On a nagging length, nipping back in a bit from outside off. Campbell shoulders arms.
Full and around off, stroked away towards cover-point.
Probing line. Khaled Ahmed gets a bit more pace behind this one and angles it in sharply into the off stump. Solidly defended out though by Campbell.
Full and around off, shaping away a bit. Easy leave for John Campbell.

Well bowled and well left as well. Mustafizur Rahman just pulls back the length a touch and bowls it really close to the off stump. Brathwaite reads the line of the ball well and makes the leave. Maiden!
Gets it a bit closer to the off pole now and keeps it full. Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper once again.
This is full but angled well across the batter, no need to play at that.
Just a shade fuller and on off, Brathwaite plays it late and defends it towards short cover.
Good-length delivery, around the top of off. Brathwaite defends it out onto the leg side.

Half an appeal from the bowler but probably going down leg. This is served on a length, around middle and leg and the ball shapes back into the right-hander. Brathwaite looks to tuck it away but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Quick single now and Kraigg Brathwaite too is off the mark! Length ball, on middle, Brathwaite plays it with soft hands in front of square on the leg side and scampers through for a run.
Fuller and bowled with good pace, close to the off pole. Brathwaite makes an assured leave.
Length this time, around middle. Brathwaite nudges it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR LEG BYES! Khaled Ahmed errs in line and gives away a few runs. Very full and angled in on the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads and runs away past the keeper into the fine leg fence.

John Campbell and West Indies are finally underway! It has taken them 32 balls but the Windies have their first run on the board. This is dug in a bit short and angled at the body. Campbell pulls it past square leg and collects a single.
Ahmed angles it in around the top of off, Campbell hangs on the back foot and keeps it out around the point region.
Fuller and on off, the batter has just watchfully blocked this out. Five overs done, West Indies are yet to open their account.
Good lines, around off and making the batter life. Kraigg defends it back.
Fullish and close to off, shaping in, Kraigg defends it from the inner half of his blade to mid-wicket.
Mustafizur Rahman receives his first official warning for running on the danger area. He has to be a bit careful now.
Outside off, left alone with ease.
Angles a full ball around off, a hint of swing, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it with soft hands.
Bowls it full and around off, Kraigg covers the line and pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on off, Campbell flicks but finds the fielder in front of square on the leg side. Make it four maidens in a row.
Short and outside off, John lets it be.

Huge shout for an lbw, not given. Too high. Back of a length, around off and angling in, John Campbell walks across and tries to pull but misses. He is hit on the thigh pad, they appeal but unsuccessfully.
Very full and on middle, Campbell flicks it across the line but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Probing delivery. This one is on a length and outside off, John Campbell is forward in defense but gets a soft outside edge. It falls in front of the slip cordon.
In the channel outside off, an easy leave for John Campbell.
Fuller and on middle, flicked to square leg. Three consecutive maidens to start this innings.
On a good length and outside off, left alone.
Rare bad shot attempted. Full and wide outside off, Kraigg goes chasing after it but fails to connect.

PUT DOWN! The leg gully fielder was there for this very reason but fails to do the job. Mustafizur Rahman pitches it around middle, on a length and gets it to shape in. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and files quickly to Mominul Haque who fails to hang on to the catch. That's a big miss, we all know Kraigg Brathwaite's appetite for big runs.
Around off, on a length, blocked from the back foot.

Uppish but safe! Movement and extra bounce from around middle, Kraigg Brathwaite tries to defend but it takes the shoulder of his bat and flies to square leg. It falls away from the fielder stationed there.

Appeal for an lbw! Nothing from the umpire, and no DRS taken either. Fuller and on middle, angling down, John Campbell tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the fielder on the leg side. Missing leg, easily.
Back of a length, on off, John covers the line and blocks it to mid on.
Fuller in length and outside off, on a driving length, John Campbell allows it through to the keeper.
Sharp pace again, full and skidding down the leg side, John attempts to flick but misses.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Campbell tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Sharp delivery first up from Khaled Ahmed. He is operating from 'round the wicket with the wind. Angles it in around off, skidding off the surface, John Campbell defends it from the back foot.
Khaled Ahmed to operate from the other end.
A touch short on this occasion, around off, Kraigg is on the back foot as he blocks it to the off side.
Pitches it up and close to off, shaping in a bit, Kraigg Brathwaite is on the front foot as he defends it down.
On a good length, around middle, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it from the back foot to the leg side.
This one is angled away from the batter, outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite allows it through to the keeper.
Again it's an excellent delivery. Mustafizur Rahman serves it around middle and leg, getting it to move back in, Kraigg Brathwaite shuffles back and defends it in front of his pads.
Starts well. Lands a full ball around off, a hint of inward shape, Kraigg Brathwaite is half-forward as he defends.
